svg.title: VERDICT: Revenue flow
svg.text: People pay for services. Nothing anyone pays or receives depends on how a verdict comes out.
1 free appeal a day, then $1.99 for the Appeals Court and $4.99
for the Supreme Court. Sold in packs of $4.99, $11.99 and
$24.99. No cash value, spent only on appeals.
Court Pass $4.99 a month or $39 a year. Group Court $9.99 a
month, shared appeal credit, up to 25 people.
Free, 10 contests a month. Pro $14.99 a month, auto-resolves
Predictions. Studio $49 a month, live appeals. Viewers never
Bailiff $250 per stream, Docket $900 a month, Season $3,500
a quarter, Supreme Sponsor from $5,000. Prizes are separate.
Verified judgment $0.25 a call, 20 free a month. Team $49 a
month. Quick judgment $0.01 is roadmap, labeled not
which is why appeals are sold in
GenLayer gas, paid by the relayer
Every money arrow stays above this line.
Below it: what a verdict decides, and what it never moves.
decided by the network, worth nothing in money
The JudgeRouter contract has no payable

No refund, credit or reward for winning an
appeal. No charge or penalty for losing one.
Channel Points only, which have no cash

If an appeal transaction fails, the free appeal or credit goes back
to the ledger. Never because of the result.

Prices are recommendations from business/monetization.md, marked there as assumptions to validate.
